EN.네 마음,|내가 맞혀 볼게: I'm going to read your mind
EN.지금부터 나를 따라\n계산만 해 줘!:
Just follow along
and do the math with me!
EN.처음 수에서\n그 합을 빼요:
Subtract that sum
from your number
EN.답이 적힌 칸의 기호를\n꼭 기억해요!:
Find your answer on the board
and remember its symbol!
EN.천천히 하고 싶으면\n화면을 꾹 눌러 멈춰요:
Need more time?
Press and hold the screen to pause
EN.기억했지?\n이제 네 마음을 읽을게…:
Got it?
Now I'll read your mind…
EN.네 기호는…\n금색 별!:
Your symbol is…
the gold star!
EN.맞았으면 댓글에\n\"별\" 하나!:
If I got it right,
comment "star"!
EN.답은 언제나\n이 아홉 칸 중 하나:
Your answer is always
one of these nine squares
EN.9 · 18 · 27 … 81 전부 별!\n다른 별은 눈속임이야:
9 · 18 · 27 … 81 are all stars!
The other stars are just decoys
EN.몇 묶음이든 묶음마다 9!: Any number works: 9 left in every bar!
EN.답은 언제나 9 의 배수\n그래서 늘 별!:
The answer is always a multiple of 9,
so it's always the star!
EN.이제 네가 마술사!:
Now you're the magician! Try it on Mom or Dad:
the two digits of their answer always add up to 9
